title: Exhortations on Sanctification and Brotherly Love
description: Paul exhorts the believers in Thessalonica that God's will is their sanctification: they must stay away from sexual immorality, live in holiness, love one another as brothers and sisters, and work with their own hands to live respectably toward those outside. [ref:1 Thess 4:1-12|1 Thessalonians 4:1-12]
